segments.name: United States (primarily Gulf of America)
segments.description: Operates offshore support vessels in the U.S. Gulf of America for oil and gas, construction, decommissioning and offshore wind farm customers.
segments.evidence: The Company's vessels in this market consist primarily of a fleet of FSVs, PSVs and liftboats that generally support oil and natural gas exploration and production activities, seasonal construction, decommissioning and diving support operations, as well as the construction and maintenance of offshore wind farms in the Northeast of the U.S.

segments.name: Africa and Europe
segments.description: Supplies fast support and platform supply vessels to major oil companies' projects offshore Angola, Nigeria and the North Sea.
segments.evidence: The Company's vessels in this market consist primarily of a fleet of FSVs and PSVs that generally support projects for major oil companies primarily in Angola, Nigeria and the North Sea.

segments.name: Middle East and Asia
segments.description: Provides fast support vessels, platform supply vessels and liftboats for exploration, personnel transport and seasonal construction across the Middle East and Asia.
segments.evidence: The Company's vessels in this market consist primarily of a fleet of FSVs, PSVs and liftboats that generally support exploration, personnel transport and seasonal construction activities in Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates and Qatar.

segments.name: Latin America
segments.description: Serves exploration and production customers in Brazil, Guyana, Mexico and Trinidad and Tobago with fast support and platform supply vessels.
segments.evidence: These vessels consist primarily of a fleet of FSVs and PSVs that generally support exploration and production activities primarily in Brazil, Guyana, Mexico and Trinidad and Tobago.

revenueModel.text: Major oil companies, independent producers, oilfield service and construction firms and offshore wind operators pay daily charter hire for vessels and marine services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company earns revenue primarily from the time charter and bareboat charter of vessels to customers.
